scope: Explicit native/Wasm/SDK generation recovery, dedicated local document/comment/version storage, original-family regressions and repaired native research/relay dependency wiring. Not whole-room generation activation or release approval.

source.postQualificationChanges: Only this record, the session guide qualification link and the V1 plan's scoped checkpoint note.

implementation.storage: Separate closed schema; immutable root/sealed files; atomic head plus exact comment journal and named versions; exact previous-head CAS; no overwrite, missing-file repair, old-database upgrade or AST fallback.
implementation.numbers: Native segment bodies remain exact strings. JavaScript does not decode and re-encode native effect or property numbers; a writer beyond JavaScript's safe integer range is covered.
implementation.lifecycle: Document and optional comment leases precede reads and native factories. Current host policies precede exposure. Failed save/close or version change retains readable recovery inputs; explicit discard waits for in-flight storage before releasing leases and large captured buffers.
implementation.retry: The exact uncertain attempt is retained ahead of newer pending captures. An already-applied head is acknowledged only with every unchanged referenced file present.
implementation.authority: Native continuity and hash metadata grant no account permission, provider acknowledgement, server activation or cross-device writer fencing. Recovery import requires an absent dedicated head and explicit host reacquisition; no roles, assets, outboxes or credentials are exported.

repairs.before: An actual restored native owner missing initial-policy capability caused open to reject without freeing the unpublished owner. The independent probe observed zero free calls.
repairs.fix: Release the owner on initial-policy refusal before facade ownership transfer. Eight normal-open/import policy/adoption failure paths now free exactly once, release both leases and preserve the durable head.
repairs.previousRun: Interrupted intentionally after reproducing the leak; never counted as a passing qualification.

repairs.before: After old compiled caches were removed, the relay's research compatibility owner failed to compile: upstream Loro lacked fork_with_undo_for_staging required by the canonical shared source.
repairs.fix: Select the same existing vendored Loro and internal implementation through direct path edges and align both research/relay lockfiles at version 1.16.2. The exact failed native fixture build, locked resolution contracts, relay tests and installed recovery now pass.
repairs.previousRun: Preserved failed installed-session-backups stage after 34 passing checks; no silent retry or stale binary substitution.

cleanup.regeneration: Cargo can rebuild the removed old dependency caches from retained source and lockfiles. Current qualification artifacts are retained separately.
